preregistration_status: new outcome-specific exploratory freeze, after site/date only preflight and old N2 temporal results; NOT a prospective untouched-dataset validation

source.site_coordinates: LocationX/LocationY, source Arc1960 UTM zone 36S EPSG:21036 transformed to WGS84 via pyproj; never display original or derived exact station coordinates
source.camera_operation_limitation: search_effort first/last valid SD-card photo date only. NO independently attested hour-level operation and q. Report camera recorded conditional event time only.

source_roster_preflight.solstice_mirror_rule: For each Dec21 solstice year y, pair dates December21-k and December21+k, integer k in [7,180], within same physical SiteID original merged valid-photo date interval. Only eligible site-cycle with >=20 such date pairs enters all taxon outcome analyses.

preprocessing.source_event_time_basis: Tanzania local civil time UTC+3; solar geometry based on year+date+site position, not fixed civil bins
preprocessing.sunrise_sunset: NOAA fractional-year declination, equation-of-time, upper limb/refraction 90.833 degrees; solar phase splits true sunrise-sunset day into central 50% core and combined first/last 25% edge; outside sunrise-sunset night
preprocessing.invalid_or_conflicting_station_coordinat: Fail closed for the station (never infer protected coordinates); if <80% of 186 structurally eligible sites have coordinate support, HOLD source outcome
preprocessing.daylength_mismatch: qualifying site/day pair must have |daylength_up-daylength_down| <=1.0 minute from site coordinates; does not re-pair for favorable animal outcomes

endpoints.primary: Source-observed time-of-recording for each species, site, solstice-cycle, branch and solar zone, counts all including zeros; no behavioral activity-time interpretation.
contrasts: falling-versus-rising descriptive odds ratio of edge vs core among recorded daylight events
falling-versus-rising descriptive odds ratio of night vs whole daylight among camera-recorded events
endpoints.site_conditioned: Mantel-Haenszel observed odds ratio stratified by physical site x solstice cycle, no event-independent p-value
endpoints.robustness: leave-one-physical-site-out range of site-conditioned observed odds ratios, retaining all prequalified source sites
endpoints.taxon_reporting: all observed species with their branch-zone counts and undefined OR when cells/denominators zero; display flag if >=100 records in each branch and >=10 source site-cycles with detections on both branches, but do not drop others

interpretational_ceiling: ONE ecological landscape (Serengeti), 225 stations not 225 independently sampled regions.
Annual rainfall migration, vegetation and camera q may vary strongly between matched solar-date branches.
No independent station x date x solar-zone camera ON-hours, no direct passage q reference.
Thus neither true latent daily animal activity, seasonal memory, sun causality, thermal refuge nor global multi-biome generality is identifiable.
Site-stratified detection time odds are descriptive, not a valid inter-animal p-value or fixed-effect causal estimate.
Original N2 17-species result remains frozen; this is a separate post-N2 exploratory study and cannot replace that endpoint.
decision_rule: Report all source counts, effect signs, undefined quantities, jackknife ranges and admissibility limits; do not tune bin boundaries, dates, species thresholds or fit method after outcomes. If missing source or geometry, HOLD rather than substitute.
